_comment: Pre-approval for the notebook's hourly wake sessions. A session that stops to ask permission is not self-paced — the wake would sit blocked until a human happened to look, which defeats the design. Scoped deliberately: reading, running varve itself, git on this repo, and writing files. Nothing here reaches outside the repo, and no credential-touching or destructive command is listed (no rm, no ssh, no key generation — key custody belongs to the operator by design, see docs/DESIGN-witnessing.md).
